Body.Content:
Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.

Users can enter full-screen mode when they need a focused planning experience and return to the standard project view when they need access to other project information.

GA date: November CY2026
